name: VC Audio Bot
description: Multi-user Telegram Voice Chat Audio Bot — in-bot login, high volume/bass/echo/boost, live mic boost, full button UI.

API_ID.description: Telegram API ID — get from https://my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: Telegram API Hash — get from https://my.telegram.org

OWNER_ID.description: Primary Telegram owner ID (numeric). Get it from @userinfobot

OWNER_IDS.description: Additional owner IDs, comma/semicolon separated. At least one of OWNER_ID or OWNER_IDS is required.

LOG_CHANNEL.description: Log channel/group ID. Default -1004303404961. Add the bot as admin there.

STRING_SESSION.description: Optional owner Pyrogram string session. Generate with @Session_generator_1bot or just /login inside the bot.

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB Atlas connection URI (recommended for persistent storage). Free tier: mongodb.com/atlas

DEFAULT_VOLUME.description: Legacy volume multiplier. Relay playback normally uses RELAY_DEFAULT_VOLUME. Default: 50000

DEFAULT_ECHO.description: Enable echo by default. Keep false for the clearest voice playback.

HEROKU_APP_NAME.description: Your Heroku app name (e.g. my-vc-bot). Used for deep links.

DEFAULT_ECHO_LEVEL.description: Echo strength 0-10. Default: 2 (only used when echo is enabled)

RELAY_DEFAULT_BASS.description: Relay bass 0-100. Keep moderate for clear speech.

RELAY_DEFAULT_TREBLE.description: Relay treble/presence 0-100. Higher values improve intelligibility.
